info.name: PlacementHub
info.description:
PlacementHub API (Milestones 3-7): health, auth, companies, drives, students, policies, drive lifecycle, admin views (applicants, CSV, criteria changes, audit, stats).

Run folders top to bottom (or use the Collection Runner). The Auth folder logs in and saves tokens (adminToken, aaravToken, priyaToken); later requests use them. Default auth is Bearer {{adminToken}}; student requests override it with {{aaravToken}} / {{priyaToken}}.

Demo password for seeded accounts: {{demoPassword}} (demo only).

Note: there is no DELETE for drives, so drives created by this collection stay in your local DB. Reset with `docker compose down -v` then `docker compose up -d` (deletes all local data).
